body:
store.html's register form now has a real Confirm Password field, validated (password !== confirm -> real error, no request sent) only on the register path -- login is unaffected. Both password and confirm-password fields get their own independent show/hide eye toggle. JS syntax-checked. Redeployed, live-verified on wotan.okemily.com/store.html (real 200, confirm-password field present). Commit 3d49641.
